vide.texte: Negotiation documents will download from the Resources tab as soon as they are published there, to be read offline. They will stay on this phone, not on your account.

place.impossible: This browser does not tell how much space Guide Négo uses: it cannot be measured on this device.
place.aide: The app itself and what it has already read, so that it opens offline.

liberer.question: Free up space on this phone?
liberer.phrase: Lists already read will be erased: they will be read again when the network returns. The app stays, with your account and the choices not yet sent — it will still open offline.
